exposure: newly introduced diagnostic criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
cohort: The study linked perinatal and hospital data for singleton births between 33-41 weeks' gestation in New South Wales, Australia, from 2006-2015.
finding: The new diagnostic criteria for GDM are associated with increased obstetric intervention rates and lower rates of macrosomic babies, but demonstrate no clear impacts on maternal or neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: The new diagnostic criteria for GDM were associated with increased rates of cesareans.
